fact: Somalia's National Communications Authority invited public comments on its draft 2023-2027 strategic plan, with the draft offered for download on its website and comments by email to consultation@nca.gov.so until 20 July 2023.

On 17 March 2024 Lower House Speaker Madobe launched a Digital Platform for Public Consultations, built by the Independent Constitutional Review and Implementation Commission, to gather citizens' feedback on the proposed constitutional amendments, per Radio Dalsan.
